label: Phone/Tablet firmware

children.name: Scaled version
children.tooltip: This firmware is designed for phone/tablet devices and includes features like short video, music switching, reading, and photography.

note:
*When reading on Android devices, set the page turner to audio mode and enable “Volume key page turning” in the reading app settings.
*For Apple devices, enable Accessibility - Zoom in the settings.

label: Computer firmware

children.name: PPT / Short video / Music switching
children.tooltip: This firmware supports PPT page turning, short video navigation, and volume control on Windows and Mac systems.

note: *Short video/music apps can be used after setting hotkeys in the app.

label: Motorcycle firmware

children.name: Entertainment
children.tooltip: This firmware is suitable for new energy vehicles and supports video playback (up/down) and volume control functions.

note: *Page-turner functionality may vary; please refer to the actual device.
